regime.label: Short gamma 52.4 points beneath a 1120 flip while the protection book builds - a Protection zone whose floor has thinned, so a break of 1050 converts it into a Squeeze.
evidence: -4,149 is cumulative net GEX (gamma x OI x 200) at spot 1067.6, deepened 2.6x from -1,573 on 2026-07-28; the cumulative only crosses zero at 1120, leaving dealers short gamma 52.4 points - 5.5 daily sigma - below the flip and forced to sell roughly 21 futures-equivalent deltas per 1-point decline.

485 contracts of put OI were added at the 1020 strike on 611 lots of volume - the largest build anywhere on the chain - alongside +270 OI on 553 lots at the 1070 put, while price fell 16.2 points: price down + put volume up + put OI up + skew tilting is the Vol2Vol signature of genuine downside-insurance demand, not stale positioning.

27,602 put OI against 15,291 call OI (1.81x) with both sides still building at 60 DTE (+5.2% puts, +10.7% calls versus 2026-07-24) - a young back-quarter accumulating insurance, the opposite of an Unwind.

1,276 contracts is all the near-money put support at 1050 versus 2,128 call OI at the 1080 wall, and the 9,759-contract 910 put wall sits 14.8% out of the money on 195 lots - Vol2Vol marks 910 as stale structural insurance, so there is no dominant near-money floor between spot and the short-gamma strip.

S50U26.today_summary: 16.2 points is the drop that reset this series: spot 1067.6 is the largest single-session decline in the five-session window and pulls price to only 7.6 points - 0.8 daily sigma - above the 1060 max-pain shelf, down from 23.8 points above on 2026-07-28. Dealers sit short gamma, with cumulative net GEX at spot at -4,149 and the flip 52.4 points overhead at 1120, so hedging amplifies rather than fades further weakness. Put flow re-engaged at 1.18 P/C volume against 0.84 on 2026-07-28, concentrated in the 1020 put (+485 OI on 611 lots) and the 1070 put (+270 OI on 553 lots), while the 1080 and 1090 puts shed 289 and 168 contracts as price fell through them. ATM IV nonetheless fell 0.88 to 14.13% on the decline, so the market is repricing distribution rather than pricing panic - long-vol structures remain cheap relative to the short-gamma risk beneath spot.
what_changed: Spot fell 16.2 points (-1.50%) to 1067.6, a 25.1-point unwind from the 1092.7 high of 2026-07-24, and closed below the 1080 call wall for the first time in the window.
Cumulative net GEX at spot deepened 2.6x from -1,573 to -4,149 while the gamma flip migrated 1110 to 1120, widening the short-gamma gap beneath spot from 26.2 points to 52.4 points in one session.
25-delta skew flipped from -0.73 (call-tilted) to +0.95 (put-rich) and the 10-delta tail steepened from +2.51 to +3.20, the clearest one-day tell that protection is being bid rather than sold.
Near-money put support migrated from 1080 to 1050 as price fell, and 1050 carries only 1,276 contracts against the 2,128 sitting at the 1080 call wall overhead.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: 25.1 points of spot decline since 2026-07-24 (1092.7 to 1067.6) has collapsed the cushion above max pain from +32.7 to +7.6 points while max pain itself drifted back 10 points from 1070 to 1060, where it has now anchored in four of the last five sessions. The higher-signal change is the gamma structure: the flip walked up from 1100 on 2026-07-21 to 1120 today while spot fell 29 points, so the gap widened from +3.4 to -52.4 points and the dealer book went from marginally short gamma to decisively short beneath spot. There has been no GEX sign flip and no unwind - call OI rose 1,478 contracts (+10.7%) and put OI 1,356 (+5.2%) versus 2026-07-24, with the 1080 call wall and 910 put wall unmoved all month, so the burden map is thickening rather than draining. ATM IV is net +0.74 over five sessions (13.39% on 2026-07-23 to 14.13%) but shed 0.88 today, meaning the 15.01% print of 2026-07-28 was the local fear peak and vol supply returned into the decline. With roughly 40 trading days left, the 1-sigma band to expiry is about plus or minus 60 points (1008-1128), which swallows the 1080 call wall, the 1020 protection build and the 1120 flip alike - so short-vol condors have no safe wings in this series.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050 / 1020
strategies.rationale: 1050 is the live near-money floor at only 1,276 contracts and 1020 is where 485 contracts of fresh protection was built today, so the structure spans the exact strip - net GEX -533, -334, -430, -547 at 1050/1040/1030/1020 - where short-gamma dealer hedging would amplify a break rather than fade it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss 8.6 points (18.1 ask - 9.5 bid), about 1,720 baht at 200 baht per point; max gain 21.4 points; breakeven 1041.4.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1080 call wall, where net GEX turns +1,348 and dealer hedging starts damping moves.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1090 / 1110
strategies.rationale: 2,128 contracts at the 1080 call wall capped the 2026-07-21 high at 1096.6 and remain the chain's largest single OI block, and 1090 sits 22.4 points - 2.4 daily sigma - above spot, so the structure sells into the 1080-1110 positive-gamma pocket that is set up to dampen a rally.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss 15.0 points (20 width - 5.0 net credit), about 3,000 baht at 200 baht per point; breakeven 1095.0. Short-vol payoff is negative-skew - size small.
strategies.invalidation: A sustained move above 1110 into the 1120 gamma flip, beyond which dealers turn long gamma and the fade thesis is gone.

S50U26.prediction: 1050 to 1080 is the battleground: below 1050 the chain's most negative per-strike GEX strip takes over and the next real shelf is the 1020 protection build, 47.6 points - 5.0 daily sigma - under spot, with nothing structural until the stale 910 wall. Above, the 1080 call wall and its +1,348 net GEX cap rallies until 1120, so the base case is a lower and wider range rather than a snap-back to the 1060 max pain, which at 60 DTE is an anchor with no pinning force yet. A close above 1080 invalidates the bearish tilt; a close below 1050 confirms the Protection-to-Squeeze conversion.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1060 max pain as a tendency, not a magnet, especially at 60 DTE where ATM gamma is still low. Defined risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss on every structure above is a real outcome. The 9,759-contract 910 put wall traded only 195 lots at 14.8% out of the money and should not be weighted as active support, and macro or news flow can override the entire option structure.
